def mean(xs):
    if not xs:
        raise ValueError("mean of empty list")
    return sum(xs) / len(xs)

def median(xs):
    if not xs:
        raise ValueError("median of empty list")
    s = sorted(xs)
    n = len(s)
    if n % 2:
        return s[n // 2]
    return (s[n // 2 - 1] + s[n // 2]) / 2

def percentile(xs, p):
    s = sorted(xs)
    k = min(int(len(s) * p / 100), len(s) - 1)
    return s[k]
